summary: Describes methods for encapsulating layer 2 protocol data units such as Frame Relay, ATM, or Ethernet for transport across an MPLS network. It documents the so-called draft-martini protocol, which has since been superseded by pseudowire specifications such as RFC 4447. It is historic.

eli5.summary: Different network types can be wrapped up and sent across a shared network. This note describes one old wrapping method, since replaced by newer ones.

questions: how to carry layer 2 frames over mpls
